process.title: Every drawing is a rung. Climb one at a time.
process.intro: Nobody starts fluent. DreamHouse was built one stage at a time, and each stage produced a real drawing, taught a real lesson and proved a real tool.

rungs.title: Pictures and a room list become a plan
rungs.lede: The first pass took a single evening: two reference pictures, a list of rooms and a schematic floor plan to react to.
rungs.what: A schematic plan shows rooms, sizes and how they connect. It is not construction detail.
rungs.why: It gives you something concrete to disagree with. Opinions get sharper the moment there is a drawing.
rungs.produces: A room-by-room layout, in metres, that the next stage can turn into a model.
rungs.caption: V1 / SCHEMATIC FLOOR PLAN / FIRST PASS

rungs.title: The plan becomes a model
rungs.lede: The same plan was rebuilt in three dimensions, out of building parts rather than a picture of them.
rungs.what: A BIM model describes walls, roofs, doors and rooms as objects that know what they are.
rungs.why: A model can be cut, counted and checked. A picture can only be looked at.
rungs.produces: A 3D model whose parts can generate drawings on demand.
rungs.alt: DreamHouse V1.1 BIM wireframe isometric drawing
rungs.caption: V1.1 / BIM WIREFRAME ISOMETRIC

rungs.title: The model gets cut open
rungs.lede: Plans and sections were pulled from the model so they could be checked. That is where the real problems showed up.
rungs.what: A review sheet is a slice through the model, such as the ground floor cut at a set height.
rungs.why: Mistakes are cheap on paper and expensive on site. A review finds them while they are still cheap.
rungs.produces: An honest list of blockers, such as garage doors that were drawn as panels but not yet modeled as real openings.
rungs.alt: DreamHouse V1.2 ground-floor BIM cut drawing
rungs.caption: V1.2 / GROUND FLOOR / BIM CUT

rungs.title: Drawings come from the model
rungs.lede: Thirteen sheets, generated from one model, so the plan, the sections and the elevations cannot quietly disagree.
rungs.what: A drafting set is the family of drawings (plans, elevations, sections) that explains a building to someone else.
rungs.why: This is the language architects and builders share. Speaking it is how an idea gets taken seriously.
rungs.produces: A coordinated schematic set in standard formats, labeled preliminary and not for construction.
rungs.alt: DreamHouse V1.3 ground-floor cut plan generated from the IFC model
rungs.caption: V1.3 / GROUND-FLOOR CUT PLAN / GENERATED FROM IFC

rungs.title: Interiors, then a real conversation
rungs.lede: The next rungs are curating the interior, then sitting down with a professional to find out what they would change.
rungs.what: Interior curation: layout, circulation, door and window openings and furniture zones, for all 21 spaces.
rungs.why: A model only becomes a home once you can walk through it and someone qualified has argued with it.
rungs.produces: A room schedule, then a walk-through with an architect or builder and a written list of their corrections.

process.status: Design status: V1.3 schematic coordination for owner review. Preliminary only: not a survey, not construction drawings, and not engineering or code approval. This is real work in progress, shown as it is.
